currentChecks.notes: Step 7 performed five targeted tests against disposable PostgreSQL/PostGIS, including both all-location and Workshop-only runs repeated twice. A fresh live demonstration passed on 9 October 2026 around 18:52–18:53 IST. It added 30 recordings and one resolved Workshop incident, preserved older records, and recalculated all three reports. The full 382-backend/34-frontend suites were not rerun for Step 7. See docs/step7/CURRENT-STATUS.md for detailed current checks and final results.

business.notes: Source: BUSINESS-CASE.md, sections 3–5. Pilot fee is an unvalidated price hypothesis. Users are facilities/security/committee reviewers, not residents, devices or paying organisations. Future site subscription hypothesis is ₹7,500–₹12,000 per community/month for up to three devices. No billing or multi-community service is implemented.

costs.notes: Device allowance excludes site-dependent installation labour and calibration. Local primary and backup storage allowance is ₹8,000–₹14,000 for two 1 TB drives. Reference/calibration allowance is ₹10,000–₹25,000 per three-device pilot, unquoted. Bare retail reference: board ₹425 https://robocraze.com/products/esp32-development-board and microphone ₹148 https://robocraze.com/products/inmp441-mems-high-precision-omnidirectional-microphone-module-i2s (listing sold out). Future cloud calculation sources: https://www.digitalocean.com/pricing/droplets ($24 4 GiB/2-vCPU VM), https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/volumes/details/pricing/ ($0.10/GiB/month), https://www.backblaze.com/cloud-storage/pricing ($6.95/TB per 30 days). Observed 9 October 2026. Exact modeled totals $37.41 for seven-day retention and $77.80 for thirty-day retention. Cloud example includes a VM, provisioned audio volume and one logical audio backup, but excludes labour, taxes, currency conversion, DB backups and redundancy. No cloud service enabled.
